"""Compile DataDefine protos into the abc_db.gen package using grpc_tools.protoc.

The generated *_pb2.py modules are committed to the repo so that the runtime
only depends on ``protobuf`` (not grpcio-tools). Re-generate with::

    uv run abc-db-gen

Custom options (options_extension.proto) are compiled together so that
``descriptor.GetOptions().Extensions[...]`` works at runtime (registry.py).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

try:
    from grpc_tools import protoc
except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - dev-only dependency
    raise SystemExit("grpcio-tools is required (dev group): uv sync --all-groups") from exc

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
PROTO_ROOT = Path(
    "~/Perforce/ABC_Project_<client>/Protobuf"
)
OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "gen"

# Expected message/enum counts in DataDefine (from earlier surveys).
EXPECTED_MESSAGES = 4726  # DataDefine only (6200 incl. NetCommand)
EXPECTED_ENUMS = 610

_IMPORT_RE = re.compile(
    r"^import (?P<mod>[A-Za-z0-9_]+_pb2)(?: as (?P<alias>[A-Za-z0-9_]+))?$|"
    r"^from (?P<frm>[A-Za-z0-9_]+_pb2) import ",
    re.MULTILINE,
)


def _build_vroot() -> Path:
    """Build a symlink virtual root with exactly one logical path per file.

    The project imports protos by bare filename (``import "UnityType.proto"``)
    while files live in subdirectories; multiple ``-I`` roots would give some
    files two logical paths (breaking protoc). Every proto basename is unique
    under the tree, so symlinking all files by basename under one root gives a
    one-to-one mapping: imports and inputs both resolve uniquely.
    """
    vroot = PROJECT_ROOT / "build" / "proto_vroot"
    vroot.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Clean previous links (keep the dir itself).
    for entry in vroot.iterdir():
        if entry.is_symlink() or entry.is_file():
            entry.unlink()
        elif entry.is_dir() and entry.name == "google":
            for sub in entry.rglob("*"):
                if sub.is_symlink() or sub.is_file():
                    sub.unlink()
    google_link = vroot / "google"
    if not google_link.exists():
        google_link.symlink_to(PROTO_ROOT / "google", target_is_directory=True)

    files = _collect_inputs()
    for proto_file in files:
        name = Path(proto_file).name
        link = vroot / name
        if link.exists():
            raise SystemExit(f"basename collision in vroot: {name}")
        link.symlink_to(Path(proto_file))
    return vroot


def _fix_imports(py_file: Path) -> None:
    """Rewrite top-level pb2 imports to package-relative ones.

    protoc emits ``import other_pb2 as x`` / ``from other_pb2 import ...``
    which breaks inside the ``abc_db.gen`` package; rewrite to ``from
    abc_db.gen import other_pb2 as x`` / ``from abc_db.gen.other_pb2 import``.
    """
    text = py_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def repl(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        if match.group("mod"):
            alias = f" as {match.group('alias')}" if match.group("alias") else ""
            return f"from abc_db.gen import {match.group('mod')}{alias}"
        return f"from abc_db.gen.{match.group('frm')} import "

    text = _IMPORT_RE.sub(repl, text)
    py_file.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def _count_definitions() -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Count messages/enums in DataDefine protos (source-of-truth check)."""
    messages = enums = 0
    for proto in (PROTO_ROOT / "DataDefine").rglob("*.proto"):
        for line in proto.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.startswith("message "):
                messages += 1
            elif stripped.startswith("enum "):
                enums += 1
    return messages, enums


def _collect_inputs() -> list[str]:
    """All DataDefine protos plus root-level shared protos (options_extension, enum)."""
    files = sorted(str(p) for p in (PROTO_ROOT / "DataDefine").rglob("*.proto"))
    for extra in ("options_extension.proto", "enum.proto"):
        p = PROTO_ROOT / extra
        if p.exists():
            files.append(str(p))
    return files


def main() -> None:
    """Compile protos and fix imports."""
    messages, enums = _count_definitions()
    print(f"DataDefine protos: {messages} messages, {enums} enums")

    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (OUT_DIR / "__init__.py").touch()

    files = _collect_inputs()
    vroot = _build_vroot()
    rel_inputs = [str(vroot / Path(f).name) for f in files]
    print(f"Compiling {len(rel_inputs)} proto files via grpc_tools.protoc ...")
    args = [
        "protoc",
        f"-I{vroot}",
        f"--python_out={OUT_DIR}",
        *rel_inputs,
    ]
    result = protoc.main(args)
    if result != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"protoc failed with exit code {result}")

    fixed = 0
    for py_file in OUT_DIR.glob("*_pb2.py"):
        _fix_imports(py_file)
        fixed += 1
    print(f"Fixed imports in {fixed} generated modules")

    if messages < EXPECTED_MESSAGES - 10:
        raise SystemExit(f"message count {messages} far below expected {EXPECTED_MESSAGES}")
    print(f"OK: generated {fixed} modules into {OUT_DIR}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
